
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the alternative hypothesis string associated with a supported Z-test
    alternative hypothesis value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Alternative hypothesis value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Alternative hypothesis string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var str = 'greater';
    > var out = {{alias}}( str )
    'greater'
    > var v = {{alias:@stdlib/stats/base/ztest/alternative-str2enum}}( str );
    > out = {{alias}}( v )
    'greater'

    See Also
    --------
